ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to lockdown fields sourced from WinZone in ATG Salesforce
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISCHANGED(StageName) ), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Name, Record type, Close Date, Owner, and Stage name are sourced from WinZone and cannot be edited
